#426 · Blimp Pokémon

Drifblim

Ghost Flying

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Drifblim is a Ghost/Flying-type Blimp Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 15 kg. It evolves from Drifloon. Its highest base stat is HP (150), with a base stat total of 498.
